title: Immunofluorescent staining for the laser microdissection of individual cells.
protocol: Use freshly cut tissue sections stored on dry ice until staining.
Wear gloves throughout the procedure and wipe down surfaces with 75% ethanol before starting.
Prepare fresh solutions prior to each dissection session.
Cut serial sections of tissue using a cryostat, ensuring they are 4-6 μm thick.
Store tissue sections on dry ice for RNA integrity preservation.
Fix slides in 75% ethanol for 30 seconds.
Wipe off excess ethanol without touching the tissue and air dry using an aerosol duster can.
Outline the tissue section with a hydrophobic marker.
Rehydrate the slide in PBS.
Place rehydrated slide in a dark box.
Add 100-200 μl antibody cocktail to cover the tissue completely.
Incubate in the dark at room temperature for 30 seconds.
Wipe away excess antibody cocktail without disturbing the tissue.
Rinse the slide in fresh PBS.
Wipe away the excess PBS.
Incubate the slide in 75% ethanol for 30 seconds.
Wipe away the excess 75% ethanol.
Incubate the slide in 95% ethanol for 45 seconds.
Wipe away the excess ethanol.
Incubate the slide in xylene for 1 minute.
Repeat xylene wash with fresh xylene for 1 minute.
Prop the slide up at an angle to air dry for 1 minute.
Remove remaining liquid using blasts from an aerosol duster can.
